source.authority: working-tree candidate; no RNCS/RFE commit, promotion, or main-branch mutation

owners: World Body IR owns event identity, authority binding, tick, sequence, and route declarations.
The shared event runtime owns candidate delivery attempts and receipts.
Concrete audio, animation, haptic, network, and telemetry Providers remain target-owned and must be explicitly admitted.

shared_node_runtime.delivery_invariant: Missing, rejected, and throwing Providers do not advance deliveredKeys; a later accepted attempt does.

local_chromium.claim_boundary: The browser route was executed and failed closed without an admitted audio Provider; this is not audio decode, playback, latency, device, or listening evidence.

commands: local Chromium candidate execution through Playwright
verification.expected_result: All listed local checks pass; no hosted CI or physical-device result is inferred.

stressCase: An authority-bound World Body event must survive IR normalization, formal routing, code generation, Studio ingress, Build presentation binding, browser Tick execution, and fail-closed Provider receipt generation.
donorAdvantage: The existing World Body Formal route plan already encoded authority-bound exactly-once delivery keys; the change promotes that donor into one shared IR runtime seam instead of adding a parallel target event system.
regressionCase: The existing browser spatial diagnostic contract, including asset_payload_receipt_root, remains preserved while the event receipt surface is added.
boundaries: No event routes are synthesized from RSR sensory events or Studio Sequence clips.
No concrete audio asset cue-to-file binding or audio decoder Provider is claimed.
No Android, physical-device, WAN, production transport, performance, or human acceptance proof is claimed.
No K400 gate is promoted to PASS.
